msg: I found that the gnomes had "on" and "off" cycles in pairs. These pairs were1. short pink gnome and tall purple gnome2. short green gnome and tall brown gnomeSo when one of these gnomes reaped lots of mushrooms (6+) I found that the partner gnome also collected lots. So if you click on the short pink gnome and get 7 mushrooms, I would suggest clicking on the tall purple one as well.When the pair of gnomes start reaping fewer mushrooms, that's when I would switch to choosing the other pair of gnomes as they would collect more.This was just my theory, and I wasn't sure as it didn't always seem to work.Things to think about when making your own theory (these are things I thought of but weren't sure on):1) I would consider 6 mushrooms or higher good (max I found was 9)2) Think about whether each gnome performed better on the left side or the right side (I really couldn't tell)3) Maybe consider the sequence of choosing (ie. does a gnome perform better based on the gnome you select beforehand?)I hope you can learn to make your own theory from this, as this was all just a guess from me.Good luck!
